description: v1.0.9 build 2026-09-08-17 CRITICAL 1292 FIX: v2_upsert_company INSERT failed SQLSTATE[22007] 'Incorrect datetime value: 1789066134 for column created_at' — the deployed companies table (and stores, from legacy 001_multi_store_location.sql) defines created_at/updated_at as DATETIME/TIMESTAMP while the ENTIRE stack writes BIGINT epoch-seconds ($now = time()). Fixes: (1) new tcEnsureEpochTimestamps() migration (called from tcEnsureNormalizedTables for companies/stores/stock_categories/products/user_accounts/audit_trails) queries INFORMATION_SCHEMA for non-BIGINT created_at/updated_at, converts existing 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' rows to epoch via UNIX_TIMESTAMP (REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' guard leaves real epochs untouched, NULL stays NULL), then MODIFYs the columns to BIGINT — idempotent, runs once, type-agnostic; (2) new tcEpochTs($value,$fallback) PHP normalizer used for created_at/updated_at/deleted_at in tcUpsertCompanyRow and tcUpsertStoreRow: numeric -> int (ms auto-detected and /1000), ISO/date strings -> strtotime, empty/invalid -> fallback ($now / NULL) — mirrors the requested sanitizeDatetime() but preserves the epoch-seconds contract the frontend expects. Acceptance: deploy head commit -> hard refresh -> add company -> console [Direct MySQL] v2_upsert_company RESPONSE {success:true} -> SHOW COLUMNS FROM companies shows created_at BIGINT -> SELECT * FROM companies WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC shows the row. Table is 'companies' (NOT tradecore_companies).
